verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer a public filing or search API, so the API-parity axis applies. The evidence only documents web UI flows (online filing, CCFS search, form downloads, live chat), mail and in-person fallbacks, and a probe of a JavaScript app shell. Nothing shows an API, let alone one at parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
